title: A Spilled Secret

lesson.themeZh: 诚实、信任与友谊中的秘密
learningObjectivesZh: 梳理Daisy向Grace透露秘密后与Beatrice之间出现的矛盾
理解Daisy选择坦白的原因，以及Grace如何回应
根据运动日开端的情节判断Daisy与Parker对活动的不同态度

sections.title: A Secret and a Beach Invitation
sections.summaryZh: Daisy担心Beatrice是否听到了她向Grace透露的秘密。Kaleem邀请Grace一起去海滩，Beatrice则提醒Daisy：如果Grace在场，Daisy就无法自在地与新遇到的动物交谈。

sections.title: Telling Beatrice the Truth
sections.summaryZh: Daisy没有继续隐瞒，而是坦白Grace已经知道她能与动物交谈。Beatrice对此很生气；Grace却礼貌地认识了Beatrice，并承诺替Daisy保守秘密。

sections.title: A Quiet Bee and Field Day
sections.titleZh: 沉默的蜜蜂与校园运动日
sections.summaryZh: 接下来的几天，Beatrice一直躲着Daisy。Daisy相信Grace值得信任。到了学校运动日，Parker却只想着赢得比赛和奖品，Daisy认为他忘了活动本来应该带来的乐趣。

questions.question: What secret had Daisy just shared with Grace?

options.text: She could understand every language.
She could talk to animals.
She was planning to leave the farm.
She was afraid of the beach.

questions.explanation: Daisy刚告诉Grace，自己能够和动物交谈。她担心Beatrice会因为Grace知道这个秘密而生气。

questions.question: Why did Beatrice object to Grace joining the beach trip?

options.text: Grace did not know how to swim.
The beach was too far away.
Daisy would not be able to talk freely to the animals with Grace listening.
Beatrice wanted Daisy to stay at home.

questions.explanation: Beatrice担心Daisy到了海滩会遇见许多新动物，但如果Grace在旁边听着，Daisy就不能和它们交谈。

questions.question: What did Daisy decide after thinking about hiding the truth from Beatrice?

options.text: She took a deep breath and told Beatrice that Grace knew her secret.
She asked Grace to pretend she knew nothing.
She blamed Kaleem for telling Beatrice.
She decided not to go to the beach.

questions.explanation: Daisy认为继续隐瞒是不对的，于是深吸一口气，直接告诉Beatrice：她已经把自己能和动物交谈的事告诉了Grace。

questions.question: What did Grace promise Daisy after meeting Beatrice?

options.text: She would ask Beatrice to leave.
She would tell the whole class about Daisy's power.
She would never visit the farm again.
She would keep Daisy's secret.

questions.explanation: Grace先礼貌地向Beatrice打招呼，随后明确答应Daisy会保守秘密，这让Daisy相信Grace值得信任。

questions.question: What bothered Daisy about Parker as Field Day began?

options.text: He refused to take part in any outdoor games.
He cared more about winning and getting prizes than enjoying the day.
He wanted to cancel the races.
He was worried that he would arrive late.

questions.explanation: Parker在教室里大声吹嘘自己会赢得所有比赛并拿走奖品。Daisy觉得运动日应该重在参与和快乐，而不是只想着获胜。

reviewNotes: 基于 GitHub Actions Run 43201460328 的真实官方素材：31段英文Text、52条字幕时间轴，Storybook HEAD HTTP 200；官方播放器标题为 Daisy Dolittle, The Disappearing Bird 1: A Spilled Secret，与本集标题 A Spilled Secret 匹配。3个教学分段按本集段落及字幕时间轴划分。5道原创英文剧情理解题分别定位 p3、p8、p10–p11、p17/p22、p30–p31，覆盖秘密引发的担忧、Beatrice反对的原因、Daisy坦白、Grace的承诺及Field Day开端。逐题核对四个不重复选项、唯一答案和具体中文解析；未使用其他集或原著剧情。
